versions.changelog:
Initial release of "passport-recognition-and-extract" skill.

- Provides intelligent extraction of key fields from Chinese passport images via Laiye ADP platform.
- Supports extraction of 13 passport fields (e.g., name, pinyin, gender, birth date, passport number) with JSON output.
- Offers CLI integration for URL, local file, Base64, batch, and async processing scenarios.
- Includes detailed quickstart guide and command mapping for common use cases.
- Out-of-the-box setup with 100 free credits/month; no prior configuration required for standard passport extraction.
